queries.constraints: SELECT c.relname AS table_name,k.conname AS constraint_name,k.contype AS kind,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid) AS definition,k.convalidated AS validated FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' ORDER BY c.relname,k.conname
queries.indexes: SELECT p.tablename AS table_name,p.indexname AS index_name,p.indexdef AS definition,i.indisvalid AS valid FROM pg_indexes p JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname=p.indexname JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace AND n.nspname=p.schemaname JOIN pg_index i ON i.indexrelid=c.oid WHERE p.schemaname='public' ORDER BY p.tablename,p.indexname
